property_summary: For any recipient and any pre-funded reward amount, after calling withdrawReward(recipient) the reference contract always sets rewardsForA[recipient] to 0 (so subsequent view of that reward is zero); the mutant that omits clearing the balance will leave rewardsForA[recipient] > 0 for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the line that sets rewardsForA[recipient] = 0 so balance is not cleared after withdrawal, changing the observable state after withdrawReward.
